figure_goal: Main-text Task 2 input figure with each input type shown exactly once.

scope_clarification.main_text: Prioritize input-format diversity: each main 3x3 panel represents a distinct user-facing file/input type.
scope_clarification.appendix: Prioritize broader domain diversity: each appendix figure may show multiple examples within the same input family.

advisor_follow_up: The Task 2 gallery should show as many possible user-facing input types as practical.

Surface meshes, scalar volumes, vector-flow volumes, and Fermi-surface-style geometry are valid input types and should remain in appendix/workflow figures even though they are not in the graph-only main 3x3 figure.
Keep surface, volume, flow, and Fermi examples organized in Appendix S4, with prototype skeleton/spatial-graph or oriented-graph results shown under the source geometry.
selection_rules: One representative example per input format.
Repeated examples of the same file format move to appendix figures.
Main panel shows the converted KnottedGraph-compatible object.
Side/source panel shows the original domain data when available.
Spatial Graph CSV examples should render embedded curved edge paths, such as points_json, rather than only straight source-target segments.
Main panels should display graph-producing inputs as explicit 3D node/edge objects, not visualization-only surfaces.
Surface, volume, vector-flow, and Fermi examples move to appendix/workflow figures where their extracted or prototype skeleton/spatial graph is shown; they remain valid Task 2 input types.
Yamada polynomial labels are appendix-only until downstream support is audited.

hamiltonian_note.rationale: The revised main gallery is organized around user-facing file/input formats whose main panels are explicit 3D node/edge graphs. Hamiltonian-derived Fermi/VTP geometry can be covered in a workflow or appendix figure where the extracted graph is also displayed.
hamiltonian_note.possible_replacement: If Hakan wants Hamiltonian input explicitly included in this gallery, add an appendix physics panel showing Hamiltonian parameters -> computed Fermi/nodal geometry -> extracted KnottedGraph-compatible spatial graph.
